title: THE DANDY JONESTOWN MASSACRE
tickerText: *** BOOK US ***  THE DANDY JONESTOWN MASSACRE ARE A 6 PIECE BAND CELEBRATING THE MUSIC OF TWO OF THE ICONIC BANDS OF THEIR TIME, THE DANDY WARHOLS AND THE BRIAN JONESTOWN MASSACRE. DRAWING UPON A RICH SELECTION OF BOTH BANDS’ DECADES-LONG MUSICAL OFFERINGS, THE DANDY JONESTOWN MASSACRE PROVIDE A MEMORABLE ADAPTATION OF BOTH ARTISTS’ WORK. WE ARE NOT A TRIBUTE BAND WHERE WE TAKE ON THE PERSONA OF THE ORIGINAL BAND MEMBERS, WE JUST SIMPLY FOCUS ON PLAYING THEIR MUSIC AND PROVIDING A MASSIVE CONCUSSION OF ROCK N ROLL. DIG IT!
